about: Regression set for the tools-only bot (phase 3). must = regexes the answer has to match (case-insensitive), must_not = regexes it must not match. Scored automatically; read the answers too. Status-dependent answers depend on IFCN's list on the day. must_not entries added 2026-10-07 for facts the prompt-stuffed bot invented (dogs on leash, bus 410/420 to Calheta, 'last bus 12:15').

questions.note: 2026-10-21, real chat (owner's friend testing): the bot said Faial is on Porto Santo, then invented 'Faial do Mar' and a bus to Ribeira Quente (Azores). Faial is the village next to Santana; if the KB has no village transport data the bot must say so, not invent.

questions.q: How do I get to Lombo Galego from Santana?
questions.note: Same chat: no data in the KB; the answer must not decorate with invented detail.

questions.q: Do I need to book PR3 on SIMplifica?
questions.note: PR3/PR3.1/PR4 (Funchal council) and PR23 (Caniço parish) are not on SIMplifica — no IFCN fee (free-walks page, IFCN list). Was answered 'booking is mandatory' before the scope:booking_scope fact (2026-10-22).

questions.q: Czy Levada do Norte jest darmowa?
questions.note: Free on its own, but one stretch is PR17 (€4.50). Was answered 'darmowa' with no caveat before scope:norte_pr17 (2026-10-22).

questions.q: Como posso pagar no SIMplifica? Aceitam MB Way?
questions.note: Multibanco, card and MB WAY (PT bank account needed for the first and last) — SIMplifica's own payment help. pr1_facts.md said 'Visa or Mastercard' only until 2026-10-22.

questions.q: I'm hiking 5 trails over 3 days including PR1. Does the 3-day rate of EUR 22.50 cover everything?
questions.note: PR1 is never in the multi-day rates.

questions.q: Which taxi company should I call for a pickup at Achada do Teixeira going to Machico?
questions.note: Achada pick-ups = Táxis Santana only (territories); was offering Táxis Machico to compare until the taxi_choice exception (2026-10-22).

questions.q: Can I cycle the Levada das 25 Fontes?
questions.note: No cycling rule anywhere in the KB: the bot must say it isn't covered, never assert a rule. It invented 'not allowed' until the prompt fix (2026-10-22).

questions.q: I'm on a cruise ship docking in Funchal for one day. Can I do a levada walk and be back in time?
questions.note: Never assume which listed ship is theirs; one day ashore = Pedra Rija / Funchal+Monte / the taxi loop, never a distant trailhead (2026-10-22).

questions.q: Sou residente na Madeira. Pago para fazer o PR1? E o estacionamento no Areeiro?
questions.note: Trail free for residents (still on the booking); parking is paid by residents too.

questions.q: We are 4 adults and 2 children (9 and 13) doing 25 Fontes. How much in total?
questions.note: 5 pay (the 13-year-old is NOT free), the 9-year-old is free but on the booking. Was answering €18 before the group-totals prompt rule (2026-10-22).

questions.q: Levada do Moinho looks closed on your site. Can I still walk it carefully?
questions.note: Must say entering a closed trail is the same offence (€250–2,500), not just repeat the status (2026-10-22).

questions.q: Which PR1 slot should I book for sunrise in December?
questions.note: December sunrise = 07:52 from trail_facts' sunrise_1st_of_month (structured field added 2026-10-22 after the model twice invented 07:15–07:30).

questions.q: Can I start the full PR1 at 3 PM today?
questions.note: Yes if a slot is free + the finish arithmetic (15:00 + ~4 h). Was a bare status dump, then an invented first-slot-only rule (2026-10-22).

questions.q: Can I walk back to Pico do Areeiro?
must: where are you|where you are|are you (now |still )?(at|on|between)
questions.note: Owner 2026-10-22: a real IE visitor (17:27, getting-back page chat) got 'Yes — you can walk back from Pico do Areeiro to Pedra Rija'. The answer depends on where they are (before Pedra Rija: yes; at Pico Ruivo / Achada: no, PR1 is one-way), so the bot must ask where they are.

questions.q: Posso voltar a pé para o Pico do Areeiro?
questions.note: Same as walk-back-where-en, in Portuguese (formal você).

questions.q: I'm at Pico Ruivo. Can I walk back to Pico do Areeiro?
questions.note: Control for walk-back-where-en: the visitor said where they are, so no question back; from Pico Ruivo PR1 is one-way.
